notes: Loops: every loop file holds the loop plus 0.35 s of the loop start repeated at the end. Loop between loopStart and loopEnd (seconds) with Web Audio (three.js: audio.setLoopStart / setLoopEnd, or AudioBufferSourceNode.loopStart / loopEnd). Do not loop the whole file.
Variants: when variants is not empty, pick one at random per play (avoid repeating the last one). A pitch jitter of plus or minus 4 percent on footsteps hides repetition further.
music_chase_calm and music_chase_intense are the same length and tempo: start both on the same audio clock time and crossfade gains with setMusicIntensity.
aliases map the game hook names (<trap>_warn, <trap>_danger, <trap>_hit, close_call) onto sound names.
volume is a suggested starting gain per sound; SFX are peak-normalised to -1 dBFS.
